scenes.description: A square face with warm beige skin. Big upturned amber eyes, softly arched brows, a soft, rounded nose and full lips. Hair: big, round afro, mint green. A full, neatly trimmed mustache. Wearing a charcoal flowing wrap robe with a trimmed collar. Broad build; moves in an easygoing way.

A diamond face with olive skin. Big narrow blue eyes with full lashes, brows that tilt up in the middle, a little worried, a strong roman nose with a curved bridge and natural, medium lips. Hair: long locs gathered loosely, dark brown. A dusting of freckles across the nose and cheeks. Wearing a chocolate open cardigan over a t-shirt. Average build; moves in a calm, unhurried way.

An oval face with deep brown skin. Round amber eyes with full lashes, dramatic high-arched brows, a small upturned nose and full lips. Hair: hair pulled up into a round bun on top, snow white. A neat pointed goatee on the chin. Wearing a charcoal v-neck t-shirt. Round build; moves in a lively, animated way.

A diamond face with warm beige skin. Round dark brown eyes with full lashes, dramatic high-arched brows, a strong roman nose with a curved bridge and a wide, generous mouth. Hair: long hair with soft curtain bangs, strawberry blonde. A pink heart painted on one cheek. Wearing a tangerine striped crew-neck t-shirt. Slim build; moves in a calm, unhurried way.

A pear face with caramel skin. Big narrow gray eyes with winged liner, low, stern brows, a small upturned nose and a wide, generous mouth in black. Hair: two long braids resting in front of the shoulders, strawberry blonde. Wearing a cherry red flowered snug turtleneck with a rolled collar and big round mouse ears. Broad build; moves in a lively, animated way.

A round face with chrome skin. Big upturned brown eyes, low, stern brows, a broad nose with wide nostrils and a small, neat mouth. Hair: chin-length bob with straight bangs, jet black. Wearing a black cosy hoodie with the hood down and drawstrings, two little red devil horns and a velvet choker with a small gem. Average build; moves in an easygoing way.
